source.name: CIHOF archive leads
source.note: Staff-review archive leads are generated from source-curation addenda. Visitor-ready records must be manually promoted in data/cihof_archive_items.json.

guardrails.publicationBoundary: Only records with status visitor-ready and visibility visitor-ready should be displayed in visitor-facing views.
guardrails.verificationBoundary: Catalog and finding-aid leads require item inspection, page/image selection, attribution, loan terms, and reproduction rights before promotion.

records.title: F34ZJK R222 - Progressive vision: the planning of downtown Cleveland, 1903-1930
records.collectionTitle: WRHS F34ZJK R222 - Progressive vision: the planning of downtown Cleveland, 1903-1930
records.sourcePageTitle: WRHS F34ZJK R222 - Progressive vision: the planning of downtown Cleveland, 1903-1930
records.displayText: Andy Chakalis is listed among the creators of a 1986 exhibition catalog tied to the same planning exhibition named in his biography. Request cover, title, credit pages, and an illustrated planning spread before display selection.
records.candidateUse: Direct work/publication lead for exhibition display.
records.rightsNote: Catalog metadata only; item inspection, page selection, credit role, loan, and reproduction permissions remain unchecked.

records.collectionTitle: WRHS Pam. Z1997 - Trideset: Cleveland, Ohio, November 1991
records.sourcePageTitle: WRHS Pam. Z1997 - Trideset: Cleveland, Ohio, November 1991

records.title: F34ZJK R511D75 Oversize - Downtown Cleveland development handbook
records.collectionTitle: WRHS F34ZJK R511D75 Oversize - Downtown Cleveland development handbook
records.sourcePageTitle: WRHS F34ZJK R511D75 Oversize - Downtown Cleveland development handbook
records.displayText: The 1983 Downtown Cleveland development handbook lists Richard Fleischman Architects, Inc. among creators and includes illustrated color plans. It can also provide municipal context for George Voinovich as mayor, without implying authorship of individual plans.
records.candidateUse: Direct firm/publication lead and contextual municipal-planning lead.
records.rightsNote: Catalog metadata only; selected plans, built/unbuilt status, attribution, loan, and reproduction permissions remain unchecked.

records.collectionTitle: WRHS F34ZYE S955 1988 - Warehouse District building conditions survey
records.sourcePageTitle: WRHS F34ZYE S955 1988 - Warehouse District building conditions survey
records.displayText: The 1988 Warehouse District building-conditions survey lists Richard Fleischman Architects, Inc. as a creator and includes plans. It may provide neighborhood preservation context for Jack Coyne, but Coyne participation is not established.

records.sourcePageTitle: WRHS MS4899 - John P. Kilroy Papers, Padraic Pearce/Pearse Center organizational documents
records.displayText: MS4899 box 1 folders 13-14 include Padraic Pearce/Pearse Center organizational documents, library proposals, grants, and minutes from 1985-1987. Request signatures and minute entries before upgrading any document to a personal McCauley connection.

records.sourcePageTitle: WRHS MS4174 - Slovenian National Home Records, common stock certificates
